help.steam_fix_tip: If the Mod menu does not appear after launching through Steam, check and repair the launch configuration under Installation and playtesting.
help.say: Write dialogue, inner voice, or narration. Narration does not require a character. Optionally link a voice from the content library.
help.show: Place a character portrait on screen. Show the character before dialogue for reliable in-game behavior.
help.hide: Remove the selected character from the screen.
help.scene: Choose a base-game background. Load preview assets to see it on the right.
help.background: Show a custom background from the image library. It is cleared when chapters or scenes change.
help.custom_cg: Show a user image fullscreen, with scale and center offsets. It is cleared when chapters or scenes change.
help.choice: Offer 2–4 choices. Each choice needs a destination step.
help.dice: Set the die range, fixed bonus, and 2–4 result bands. Each band has text and a destination. Uses the base-game dice panel.
help.goto_scene: Leave the current story for free mode, the title screen, a death screen, an ending, or another selected scene.
help.end: End this chapter. Leave Next chapter empty to return to free mode.
help.death: Show a base-game-style death screen. Text is required; use a custom ID above 900000.
help.intro: Base-game characters use their existing introduction and portrait. Custom characters can have a title, name, and description.
help.raw: Advanced: insert code verbatim into Lua. Ordinary stories do not need this node.
help.music: Play base-game music or music imported into the content library.
help.sound: Play a named base-game sound or an imported sound effect / ambient track.
help.combat: The character selects battle animations only. Health, stamina, stats, skills, ultimates, and action probabilities are independent and are not copied from the character.
help.battle: Configure allied and enemy factions and headcounts. Verified named characters can be added and count toward their side’s total.
help.battle_result: Branch on victory or defeat using the battle result recorded for this project’s current chapter.
help.reward: Grant multiple rewards, such as stats, affinity, talents, and items, in one step.
help.result_screen: Show a results title and description, then grant the specified rewards.
help.custom_shop: Choose manuals, miscellaneous items, and valuables to sell. One discount applies to all items; individual prices cannot be set.
help.stat_check: Compare a player stat with a target value and choose destinations for pass and fail.
help.affinity_check: Compare a character’s affinity with a target value and choose destinations for pass and fail.
help.item_check: Check whether the player owns an item and set destinations for each result.
help.talent_check: Check a talent level and choose destinations for pass and fail.
help.flag_check: Check a Mod flag, a base-game boolean condition, or a base-game numeric flag.
help.activity: Configure training, study, forging, and other activities with messages, conditions, time costs, and rewards.
help.mod_quest: Update this project’s quest progress without changing base-game quests.
help.quest_check: Check a quest state in the current package and branch on a match or mismatch.
help.persistent_var: Store an integer for this project, such as a completion count. Writes require a project-specific save; base-game saves and temporary previews cannot write it.
help.persistent_check: Read a stored project integer and branch on the comparison. A record not yet saved reads as 0.
help.overlay: Display foreground art, props, illustrations, or masks in separate slots. Choose an anchor, layer, scale, and opacity.
docs.window_title: Documentation — Legend of Mortal Scenario Editor
docs.title: Documentation
docs.software_search: Search editing, playtesting, export, or installation…
docs.home_intro: Offline reference generated from the editor’s schema. Search nodes, fields, and runtime bridge APIs in one window.
docs.contract_note: The editor writes Story JSON, lomc validates and compiles it, and MortalModHost connects supported features to the base game.
docs.how_to_note: Choose a category or search by UI label, JSON key, node type, or runtime API. Each page lists requirements, defaults, a minimal example, and compatibility notes.
reference.search: Search nodes, fields, or runtime APIs…
reference.node_id_contract: A string unique within the chapter
reference.goto_contract: Optional node reference; overrides sequential flow
reference.runtime_note: The editor saves Story JSON and lomc generates Lua. Authors do not need to call this API directly.
reference.compatibility_note: Use only the listed fields; the compiler rejects unknown fields. Base-game IDs come from extracted data. Regenerate and retest after game updates.
reference.kind.game_or_user_id: Base-game ID or user: content reference
reference.kind.node_ref: Target node ID in this chapter
reference.kind.story_ref: Chapter ID in the same Mod package
reference.kind.target_table: Table mapping text, conditions, or results to target nodes
reference.kind.nonempty_table: Structured table with at least one entry
help.enemy: Change faction status for large battles: current enemy faction, faction size, headcount, or cohesion. This does not configure a duel opponent.
help.battle_skill: Configure battle skills and their levels.
reference.kind.dice_bands: 2–4 result bands ordered by increasing score
reference.effect.id: Uniquely identifies this node within the chapter for jumps and error messages. Hidden from players.
reference.effect.type: Selects the node behavior used by the compiler. Fixed by the node type.
reference.effect.flow_target: Jump to the selected node when the result corresponding to “{field}” occurs.
reference.effect.required: Set “{field}” for this node. The compiler rejects a build if it is missing.
reference.effect.optional: Optionally override “{field}”. Leave empty to retain the node’s default or base-game behavior.
reference.effect.combat_background: Select the base-game background for this duel independently of its character or internal duel template.
reference.effect.combat_character: Choose a base-game or custom character for four battle animation categories. This does not populate or restrict combat stats.
reference.effect.combat_vital: Override “{field}” for this duel. If empty, the runtime provides a stable default.
reference.effect.combat_stat: Override the opponent’s “{field}” stat used by the base-game duel calculations.
reference.effect.combat_talents: Set each skill and level available to the opponent in this duel.
reference.effect.combat_rate: Set the base-game AI’s probability of choosing “{field}”, from 0 to 1.
reference.effect.battle_title: Replace the enemy-name line in ReadyPanel. If empty, use the current battle template’s faction name.
reference.effect.battle_health: Override “{field}” for this battle. CharacterHealth clones HealthData without modifying base-game assets.
reference.effect.battle_faction: Add factions to “{field}” and set their headcounts individually. The total includes these troops and named characters.
reference.effect.battle_characters: Add verified base-game named characters. Each is added to the side’s headcount separately.
reference.effect.dice_max: Set the random roll’s upper bound. This node rolls an integer from 0 through this value.
reference.effect.dice_header: Title at the top of the base-game dice panel.
reference.effect.dice_bonus: Add a fixed integer to the roll; negative values are allowed.
reference.effect.dice_bonus_name: Display the bonus source, such as “Agility”. This label does not change the bonus value.
reference.effect.dice_bonus_status: Display an extra description of the bonus without changing its value.
reference.effect.dice_bands: Configure 2–4 bands in increasing order of maximum reachable score. Each has text and a target; the last catches remaining scores.
help.free_trigger: Register a free-mode location trigger. When the player visits the location and all month, period, flag, and affinity conditions match, play the selected story. This node does not run as a story step and is usually placed after End story. Export collects triggers into the manifest; handwritten manifest triggers take priority, followed by node order.
field_help.other: Enter a value required by the game.
field_help.code: Raw Lua inserted verbatim into the story.
field_help.node_ref: An existing step ID in this story. Invalid IDs cause export errors.
field_help.story_ref: Story script ID in the same Mod package. Leave empty if unused.
field_help.death_id: Custom death screen ID. Do not reuse it within the same Mod.
field_help.character: Choose a base-game character ID, or a user: reference for custom content.
field_help.portrait: Expression name from the character’s available portraits.
field_help.position: Character position on the stage, including left/right and front/back.
field_help.stat: Character stat, such as strength, money, or reputation.
field_help.item: Choose an item ID from its category in the game catalog.
field_help.game_flag: Flag name in game save data, persistent across stories and saves.
field_help.affinity_character: A base-game character whose affinity can be changed.
field_help.affinity_optional: Choose “Any” to omit the affinity condition.
field_help.voice: Voice resource name. Leave empty for no voice.
field_help.user_image: Custom image reference in the content library.
field_help.ending_image: Illustration on the ending card’s left page. Must be under assets/ in the package.
field_help.intro_image: Introduction card image. Must be under assets/ in the package.
field_help.goto_scene_key: ID required by the destination scene; requirements differ by scene.
field_help.branch_source: Condition source: Mod flag, game save flag, or condition expression.
field_help.options: Each row is a choice with a destination step ID in this story.
field_help.cases: Each row is a branch: value and destination.
field_help.dice_bands: Order bands by increasing maximum reachable score. The last band catches remaining scores.
field_help.reward_entries: Each row grants a reward. Leave its condition empty for unconditional rewards.
field_help.custom_shop_items: Each row is one shop item.
field_help.battle_faction_list: Additional troops. Set each count; totals are calculated automatically.
field_help.official_characters: Choose from the base-game character list.
field_help.vars: Custom variable table: name and initial value.
field_help.menu_dialog: Dialog style for the choice panel.
field_help.end.next_script: Play this script next instead of returning to free mode. Leave empty to end normally and return to free mode.
field_help.goto_scene.key: Duel / battle requires a battle ID; ending / death requires its ID. Other scenes do not need one.
field_help.free_trigger.position: Evaluate when this fixed game-map location is clicked in free mode.
field_help.free_trigger.script: Story to play when all conditions match. Must be a script ID in this Mod package.
field_help.free_trigger.when_month: Trigger only in this month. “Any” allows every month.
field_help.free_trigger.when_stage: Trigger only in this period of the month. “Any” allows all periods.
field_help.free_trigger.when_flag_set: Trigger only when this story flag is set. Set it in an earlier story to unlock this event afterward.
field_help.free_trigger.when_flag_clear: Trigger only while this flag is unset. Useful for one-time first encounters.
field_help.free_trigger.when_affinity: Choose a character for an affinity requirement, or “Any” to skip the check.
field_help.free_trigger.when_affinity_mi: Require this character’s affinity to be at least this value. Zero selects the character without imposing a lower bound.
field_help.free_trigger.note: Private note stored in the story file. Does not affect the game.
help.parallel: Start several presentation actions together and continue after all finish. Edit character, movement, exit, transition, and audio actions within the group. Keep dialogue, choices, combat, jumps, and raw Lua outside it.
help.move: Move an on-screen character between positions. A longer duration means slower movement.
help.face: Change an on-screen character’s left/right facing.
help.focus: Highlight the selected character and dim the others. Show the character first.
help.offset: Adjust a character’s current position using pixel offsets and an optional duration.
help.shock: Shake an on-screen character for a set duration, for surprise or impact.
help.mask: Show or hide the screen mask used for monologues.
help.effect: Play or stop a base-game screen effect. Parameters vary by effect; retain defaults when unsure.
help.transition: “Fade in” covers the screen with black; “Fade out” reveals it. Cover the screen, change the background and characters, then reveal the new scene.
help.camera: Enable or disable a camera filter to change the visual style.
help.block: Advanced: call an existing game presentation block by name. Ordinary authoring can skip this.
help.cg: Show an existing game image or title by resource name. Use Fullscreen CG or Custom background for your own images.
help.dim: Dim the selected character. Uncheck to restore normal brightness.
help.message: Show a short system message in the game.
help.rotate: Rotate an on-screen character by an integer angle. Positive means counterclockwise; duration is optional.
help.dayenv: Switch presentation lighting between day and night.
help.stat: Add to a player stat. Positive values increase it; negative values decrease it.
help.stat_set: Set a player stat directly to the specified value.
help.affinity: Change a character’s affinity. Positive values increase it; negative values decrease it.
help.talent: Increase or decrease a talent level.
help.item: Grant or remove a specified quantity of an item.
help.flag: Record something in this project, such as meeting the sect leader. Check it later with a conditional branch.
help.game_flag: Change an existing game numeric story record using its exact name. Use Story flag for your own project’s events.
help.mission: Operate on an existing game mission by name. Use Mod quest for custom quests.
help.time: Advance or change game time. Choose an operation and enter a date or period.
help.autosave: Trigger a game save of the selected type. Project campaign saves are separate from base-game saves.
help.branch: Check a story record or value and jump to the matching step. Every branch needs a destination.
help.panel: Open an existing game system panel, such as a shop, and set the options it requires.
help.wait: Pause story progression for the specified seconds. Inside a parallel group, this sets a minimum duration for the group.

preflight.title: Preflight check
preflight.hint: Double-click a chapter or step issue to locate it. Project export issues open release settings. Automatic fixes only handle unambiguous changes and can be undone.
preflight.release_settings_saved: Release settings saved. Run Release preflight again to see remaining issues.
preflight.stage_missing: Character {name} may not be on screen here, which can cause a black screen. Automatic repair inserts a show-character step first.
preflight.unreachable_node: This step cannot be reached from the story’s beginning. Check preceding jumps unless it is spare content.
preflight.broken_flow: This step has no successor and is not an ending. Add a next step or make it an ending.
preflight.infinite_loop: This step is in a loop with no reachable ending; the player would be trapped.
preflight.placeholder: Example or placeholder text remains. Replace it before release.
preflight.back_pos: Character appears at rear position {pos} and may be obscured. Consider L2, M, or R2 for ordinary entrances.
preflight.missing_image: Image {image} is missing. Choose it again.
preflight.large_image: Image {image} exceeds 8 MB. Compress and select it again.
preflight.unreachable_story: Chapter {story} cannot be reached from starting chapter {entry}.
preflight.invalid_entry: Starting chapter {entry} is invalid or missing.
preflight.invalid_trigger_story: Event trigger #{index} points to missing chapter {target}.
preflight.no_exit_scc: This chapter belongs to a cross-chapter loop with no reachable ending.
preflight.read_before_write: Mod flag {name} may be read before being written on at least one reachable path.
preflight.impossible_content: Content reference {ref} cannot be used in this field. Voices require user:namespace.name.
preflight.illegal_content_path: Invalid content path {ref}: absolute paths, parent directories, and path-shaped user: references are forbidden.
preflight.missing_content: User content {ref} is missing or has been removed from the library.
preflight.unused_content: User content {ref} ({kind}) is not referenced by this project. It will not be deleted automatically.
preflight.stale_registry: The content registry.json is damaged or differs from disk. Save the library again to refresh the index.

variables.title: Variables / flags
variables.intro: Analyze structured nodes only; raw Lua is not inferred. Base-game flags and flowchart variables may be consumed by the game and are not automatically labeled unused.

conditions.title: Condition inspector
conditions.intro: Inspect structured branches. Conditions are marked always true only when a dominating write proves them; unknown runtime state is not guessed.

paths.title: Story path simulator
paths.summary: Analyzed {stories} chapters / {nodes} nodes: {issues} confirmed issues; {unknown} conditions depend on unknown runtime state and have no definite simulated result.

paths.detail.dead_branch: The condition is proven; value={value} → {target} cannot execute.
paths.detail.missing_ending: No final end, scene endpoint, or death ending is reachable from this chapter. Raw Lua is not inferred.
paths.detail.bad_trigger: Campaign trigger #{index} points to missing chapter {target}.
